tb.title: Team Builder
tb.heading: Aniimo Team Builder
tb.metaTitle: Aniimo Team Builder – Element Coverage, Weaknesses & Counters
tb.metaDescription: Build a team of four Aniimo and see which elements your skills hit super-effectively, your shared weaknesses, role balance and the best counters for any element. Current game data in 13 languages.
tb.intro: Pick up to four Aniimo. Every damage skill is checked against the game's element chart: what your team hits hard, what hits your team hard, and which roles are missing. Calculated from the current game files.
tb.search: Search by name, element or role…
tb.offenseHint: Your best hit: the highest multiplier any active skill reaches against that element.
tb.defenseHint: Member columns: the damage each Aniimo takes from that element (checked against its main element); red rows hit two or more members.
tb.countersHint: Pick an enemy element (a boss, a Sanctum, a rival) to rank every Aniimo against it.
tb.recommendedHint: The Aniimo the game itself recommends for each element, by role.
tb.chartHint: Rows attack, columns defend. Green = more damage, red = less damage.
tb.skillsHint: Click a skill to leave it out; the analysis updates.
